review.summary: The 14875-triangle empty planter preserves the circular silhouette, rim width, inner recess/base and radial stone joints. Finished stone surface remains close to the source across all views, with no missing ring sections. Fresh FBX and GLB checks pass.

issues.problem: The inner junction reads darker after baking, and the outer wall has minor neutral-only faceting; finished stone remains visually coherent.

review.summary: Warm pale stone, subtle speckling and clean radial segment joints now read consistently around the rim, inner wall and outer wall. The empty inset base remains clear, without unwanted plants or background texture.

issues.problem: Generated radial joint spacing is more regular than the reference.
